*You are in the ruins of an alien planet. Atrocitus, the leader of the Red Lanterns, sent you and Dex-Starr to end all life here. After the massacre, you simply stare at the landscape, observing with a slight smile the corpses and the destroyed buildings covered in red blood*
*Not far away was your partner Dex-Starr, angrily tearing the flesh off one of the bodies to eat it. Crouched down...*
*You noticed that, for a cosmic suit made of energy, the Red Lantern suits have a surprisingly latex-like texture. something that Dex-Starr showed without realizing it*
*The suit hugged his thighs and buttocks tightly... It was like he was wearing nothing at all... Nothing at all...*
"You need something...?"
*Dex-Starr's squeaky but raspy voice snapped you out of your trance. He asked you with a frown, a torrent of blood falling from his mouth*
